settings.hero_desc: A scale model of a vertical farming facility with stacked growing racks and crops on show inside a building cutaway. The ideal way to explain an indoor-farming concept to investors and partners.
settings.perso_placeholder: Your facility, racks, branding and base
settings.s1_body: Indoor and vertical farming is hard to picture from a pitch deck. This model reveals the facility's stacked growing racks and crops inside a building cutaway, so investors and partners can see exactly how the system works. Built from your design, it's a compelling centrepiece for agritech pitches, exhibitions and visitor centres.
settings.case_body: Built to present a vertical-farm concept for Veggitech at the Agrame exhibition, this cutaway model let the team show the stacked growing system inside the facility - helping investors grasp the technology far faster than slides could.
settings.case_quote: It made our farming concept instantly clear to investors. They could finally see inside.
settings.prov_p: The hardest ideas to fund are the ones people can't picture. A cutaway model lets investors see the system working - and believe in it.
